trap.label: hábito em narrativa e pergunta
trap.wrong: Children would to gather around the fire. Could you tell me how was the river born?
trap.right: Children would gather around the fire. Could you tell me how the river was born?
trap.why: Em português “as crianças se reuniam” e “como o rio nasceu” seguem a ordem direta. O brasileiro insere to após would e inverte a pergunta indireta. Em inglês: would + base; ordem afirmativa.

mcq.q: Could you tell us how the river ___?

fix.wrong: Tell me why did it happen.
Could you tell me when was it built?
fix.right: Could you tell me when it was built?

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com would: “Elders told stories every night.”
rewrite.answer: Elders would tell stories every night.

rewrite.prompt: Torne indireta: “How was the river born?” (Could you tell us...)
rewrite.answer: Could you tell us how the river was born?

rewrite.prompt: Torne indireta: “Why did it happen?” (Tell me...)
